---
title: "Interface"
---

This section of the documentation focuses on how the interface is implemented.
It is split into the following set of documents:

- The [inputs](inputs.qmd#inputs) accepted by Sprout, specifically the object
  types used to represent properties and data.
- The main [outputs](outputs.qmd#outputs), including the files, folders, and
  Python objects produced by Sprout.
- The [command-line interface](cli.qmd) commands and their overall design.
- The [Python library](python.qmd) for how Sprout might be used within Python
  code.
